title: Mahasthan Brahmi Inscription
seoTitle: Mahasthan Brahmi Inscription - Earliest Bengal Epigraphic Record
seoDescription: Banglapedia reference on the Mahasthan Brahmi inscription, early urbanization, Mauryan authority, and exchange evidence in Bengal.
note: Reference on the fragmentary Brahmi inscription from Mahasthan, described as the earliest epigraphic record in Bengal.
whyItMatters: It directly supports claims about Pundranagara, early urbanization, Mauryan-period administration, relief measures, and early exchange media in Bengal.
